description: Typical agent Scheme workloads: pure transforms over tool-shaped dicts/lists. No IO.

tasks.title: Filter open rows and project fields
tasks.prompt: From `rows`, keep only status equal to "open". Return a list of dicts with only :id and :score for each kept row, same order.

tasks.title: Nested read and pure update
tasks.prompt: Build a NEW user dict where profile name is "Ada Lovelace" and a new top-level :greeting is the string made from "Hello, " and the new name. Do not mutate. Return the new dict. Prefer nested path helpers if available.

tasks.title: Pipeline: filter, sort, take
tasks.prompt: From `events`, keep kind "click", sort remaining by :n descending, take the top 2, return the list of their :n values (numbers only).

tasks.title: Group by field and count
tasks.prompt: Return a dict mapping each :kind string to how many items have that kind. Keys may be strings.

tasks.title: Mixed-type string report
tasks.prompt: Return one string: each person as "Name=…;Age=…" joined by " | " (spaces around the pipe). Example shape: "Name=Ann;Age=30 | Name=Bo;Age=21".

tasks.title: Missing key defaults
tasks.prompt: Return a dict with :host from cfg, :retries from cfg, and :timeout equal to cfg's :timeout if present else 30. Missing keys are nil/null — treat that as absent.

tasks.title: Define helpers and compose
tasks.prompt: Define a helper `(ok? row)` that is true when :ok is true. Define `(ids xs)` that maps :id over a list. Return (ids of only ok rows).

tasks.title: Branching map enrichment
tasks.prompt: Map each score dict to a new dict with the same :id, same :n, and :label equal to "neg" if n<0, "zero" if n=0, else "pos".

tasks.title: Join two lists by id
tasks.prompt: For each user, find the stats row with the same :id and return a list of dicts {:id :name :hits} in the order of `users`. Every user has a matching stats row.

tasks.title: Conditional reduce
tasks.prompt: Sum :amt for type "credit" only. Return a single number.
